safety: Curtains are code-native solid rectangles. Sighs are built-in image_gen transparent native glyphs, registered independently with uniform scale/translation. No original face/hair/clothing/background RGB is copied. Source fullrate images only measure events and graphic positions. Rejected code-extracted canonical glyphs are not used. Graphic-only transforms do not transform character.
limits: Sigh opacity and translation estimated by masked high-frequency glyph-template matching, not original author alpha; no claim of pixel-exact effects. Null detection means clear that glyph for that source frame.
render_order: DS native full pose -> original-time independent sigh or curtain -> screen-fixed black square. Remove source-baked sighs from all underlying A/B assets; do not double overlay.
